scripts.check: pnpm run check:static && pnpm run check:stack && pnpm run test:e2e:live
scripts.check:static: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run check:brand && pnpm run check:tokens && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:imports && pnpm run check:audit && pnpm run check:migrations && pnpm run check:transitions && pnpm run check:events && pnpm run check:functions && pnpm run check:workflows && pnpm run check:docs && node scripts/check-unimported.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/check-unimported.test.mjs && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.check:stack: pnpm run db:test && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run check:types && pnpm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json && pnpm --filter app typecheck
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter app exec vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:smoke && pnpm run test:e2e:live
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL= EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY= pnpm --filter app exec expo export --platform web --clear && node scripts/build-mode.mjs write smoke && playwright test
scripts.check:types: supabase gen types typescript --local | diff -u packages/contracts/src/db.generated.ts - || (echo "check:types: packages/contracts/src/db.generated.ts is stale — run pnpm gen:types" >&2; exit 1)
scripts.check:workflows: node scripts/check-workflows.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/ci-gates.test.mjs scripts/workflow-hygiene.test.mjs scripts/ci-scope.test.mjs scripts/set-secret.test.mjs scripts/e2e-live-scopes.test.mjs scripts/rotate-invite-key.test.mjs
